title: Supplementary alternate work sites need approved boundaries and verified safeguards
remediation: The sponsor workplace security lead and system owner identify assessed alternate work sites or approved site classes and the safeguards selected for them. Inspect a redacted site approval and verify applicable safeguards or a documented restriction of work activities. Record the owner, review date and any unapproved site disposition.

milestones.title: Collect approved alternate-site classes and safeguards, a masked site assessment and a dated approval or restriction decision
